notes.title: Race of Life Act 1 - hotfix v1.04.5
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We’ve just fixed an issue that was affecting access to saves made before the last hotfix. The good news is: your pre-update saves SHOULD now work again! 🎉If we didn't f*ck something up in the process, that is.

However, we also want to be honest with you — this fix may have caused some saves made after April 10th (in specific scenes) to no longer function correctly. We’re really sorry about that. 😔

Over the past few days, we’ve been working hard to understand and solve this issue. Unfortunately, it was something out of our control — it’s a rare problem that can occur with the engine we use to build the game. This was our first time encountering it too.

We truly hope this won't happen in future updates, but we can’t promise it won’t — though we’ll do everything we can to prevent it.

Also, good news: we might have fixed the issue where the walkthrough wasn’t launching properly. If you had trouble with that before, please give it another try after this update and let us know if it works for you!

We're really sorry for the inconvenience, and we hope those of you who started new saves recently will understand the situation. If you need to replay the game from the beginning, take use of the skip function. You can also turn on "Skip the unseen" option in settings - it'll speed up the process even more.

Thanks so much for your support and patience!

notes.notes: I uploaded a simple hotfix that fixes some typos and a few bugs in Chinese version, mainly game crash in the parking lot scene with Veronica.

notes.title: Release is Just Around the Corner! 🎉
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44563870/94e9c596f5b06d9e8b9da107935f595832461d9d.png

We're down to just a few days until launch, and we're putting the final touches on everything! We're excited to announce that we've added the last batch of achievements—there will be 56 for you to unlock! 🏆✨

Unfortunately, we had to temporarily remove support for some languages. But don't worry—they’re not gone forever! We're in the final stages of translating the last episode into additional languages, and the sheer volume of text has been a massive challenge for our translators.

To avoid delaying the launch further, we've decided to release the game with Polish, Turkish and Simplified Chinese fully supported at launch. We're actively working on Russian, which will likely come shortly after release. We're also making great progress on Brazilian Portuguese, Spanish, French, and Italian, with plans to include them as soon as possible post-launch.

We deeply apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding. Thank you for your patience and support as we work to bring the game to as many players as possible! ❤️

Mark your calendars—January 10th is the day, and we can't wait to share this adventure with you! 🚀

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44563870/a06b804843d05f98e674cd25c05146e2370b19be.png

notes.title: Official Release Date for Race of Life: Act I - January 10, 2025!
notes.notes:
🚨 Official Release Date for Race of Life: Act I - January 10, 2025! 🚨
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44563870/1721c8b70ae2665f927096cf1ea29beba0ddf06d.png

🎉 After countless hours of designing, rendering, and testing, we're thrilled to announce that Race of Life: Act I will officially launch on January 10, 2025! 🎮

📅 We know the game was originally planned for a 2024 release, but we wanted to avoid the busy holiday season 🎄✨ with Christmas and New Year’s Eve🎆. After careful consideration, we decided that early January is the perfect time to kick things off! 🚀

🙏 We sincerely apologize for the delay. Unfortunately, delays are a common challenge in indie game development, as we often underestimate the time required to bring our vision to life. That said, we’re incredibly proud of what we’ve created! 

Here’s what awaits you:
🔥 8-12 hours of gameplay
📸 Over 11,000 images
🎥 Over 500 animations
🚗 Animated racing scenes - make the right choices and win!
❤️‍🔥 25 lewd scenes with various women and 4 Extra Scenes we hope you’ll fall in love with

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44563870/45efe7530fc8ec43377bf1b4b5e019a994aa06a3.jpg

The content is packed because Jake’s life is as intense as it gets! 🌟 Buckle up for the ride of a lifetime. 🚗💨
Leading up to the release, we’ll introduce you to more characters 👥, let you get to know them better, and set the mood for Race of Life. 🏁

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44563870/95ea26f76186b680284a59afb3b7e2de1f218ea6.jpg

💖 Thank you for your patience and support—it means the world to us. 🌍 See you at the starting line on January 10th! 🏎️✨

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44563870/bbe0a636f51df9a871141440ebad34234375635f.jpg
